title: 第11章 方羽的果断第12章 陆玄赠剑
slug: 顶级悟性从修炼基础剑法开始
lines: 第十一章方羽的果断
“救救我。”
周围不少矿奴，发出一声声求助。
方羽面色冷漠，一路狂奔。
“是那罪子？他居然没死，怎么可能。”
很快就有人认出了方羽，看着一路狂奔的方羽众多矿奴纷纷惊声开口说道。
很快方羽就来到矿坑出口。
而此时矿坑的异动，已然吸引陆玄等人的注意，无数护卫齐聚在矿坑之外。
看着不断涌出的矿奴，陆玄眉头紧锁。
就在此时，陆玄看着矿坑出口，眼中精光绽放。
看着那道身影，陆玄脸上的神色，一时间也不由陷入了呆滞之中。
不止陆玄，周围那些护卫，看着那道身影，脸上也都露出了难以置信之色。
“他居然出来了？”
“这怎么可能？我算的没错的话，他在矿坑之中，应该是待了将近六天了吧。他怎么活下来的。”
众多护卫看着自矿坑走出的方羽，纷纷震惊的开口说道。
方羽在周围众多矿奴和护卫的目光下，走出矿坑。
就在此时，陆玄身形一动，几个纵身，就落在方羽的身前。
陆玄打量了方羽一番。
方羽面无表情的看着陆玄。
“矿坑之中发生了何事？”
陆玄看着方羽沉声开口问道。
方羽看了陆玄一眼，随后沉声开口说道。
“寒阴地龙苏醒了。估计要出来了。”
“什么？”
陆玄听到方羽之言，当下面色大变道。
随后陆玄思忖了一番之后，皱着眉头对着方羽沉声开口说道。
“如今乃是白日，寒阴地龙应该在沉睡之中，你可知道上报假消息的后果。”
方羽听到之后，看了一眼陆玄，想到连造化神碑都让他赶紧跑，可见下方必然出现了连造化神碑都无法应付的存在。
“求援吧，不然就放弃九号矿坑，跑。”
方羽对着陆玄沉声开口说道。
陆玄看着方羽那郑重的神色，深深的看了方羽一眼，随后陆玄伸出手来，一个通体黑色的圆柱体出现在其手中。
content_en:
Chapter 11 Fang Yu’s decisiveness
"Help me."
...
There were many mining slaves around, calling for help.
Fang Yu looked indifferent and ran all the way.
"Is it the sinner? He is not dead. How is it possible?"
...
Someone soon recognized Fang Yu, and many of the mine slaves looked at Fang Yu running wildly and spoke in shock.
Soon Fang Yu arrived at the exit of the mine.
At this time, the unusual movements in the mine had attracted the attention of Lu Xuan and others, and countless guards gathered outside the mine.
Lu Xuan frowned as he looked at the mining slaves that kept pouring out.
At this moment, Lu Xuan looked at the exit of the mine, his eyes shining brightly.
Looking at that figure, the expression on Lu Xuan's face couldn't help but fall into a dull state for a moment.
Not only Lu Xuan, but also the guards around him looked at that figure with expressions of disbelief on their faces.
"He actually came out?"
"How is this possible? If my calculation is correct, he must have been in the mine for nearly six days. How did he survive?"
...
Many guards looked at Fang Yu coming out of the mine and said in shock.
Fang Yu walked out of the mine under the gaze of many mine slaves and guards around him.
At this moment, Lu Xuan moved, jumped up, and landed in front of Fang Yu.
Lu Xuan looked at Fang Yu.
Fang Yu looked at Lu Xuan expressionlessly.
"What happened in the mine?"
Lu Xuan looked at Fang Yu and asked in a deep voice.
Fang Yu glanced at Lu Xuan, and then said in a deep voice.
"The Hanyin Earth Dragon has awakened. It is probably coming out."
"What?"
When Lu Xuan heard Fang Yu's words, his expression suddenly changed.
Then, after Lu Xuan thought for a while, he frowned and spoke to Fang Yu in a deep voice.
"It's daytime now, Hanyin Earth Dragon should be sleeping. Do you know the consequences of reporting false news?"
After Fang Yu heard this, he glanced at Lu Xuan and thought that even the Monument of Creation told him to run away. It can be seen that there must be a being below that even the Monument of Creation cannot deal with.
"Ask for help, or else abandon Mine No. 9 and run."
Fang Yu said to Lu Xuan in a deep voice.
Lu Xuan looked at Fang Yu's solemn expression and gave Fang Yu a deep look. Then Lu Xuan stretched out his hand, and a black cylinder appeared in his hand.
